scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.local: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix backend run dev:local" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix backend run dev:local" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:bun: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "bun --cwd backend run dev" "bun --cwd frontend run dev"
scripts.local:bun: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "bun --cwd backend run dev:local" "bun --cwd frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
